newsitem.title: USA: Female Health insiders purchase shares.
newsitem.headline: Female Health insiders purchase shares.

text.p: Female Health Co said Tuesday that three directors including the company's chairman and president purchased a total of 79,000 shares of the company's common stock during April.
The company, which markets the Reality female condom, has about 8.7 million shares outstanding.

As of January 29, 1997, chairman and chief executive officer O.B. Parrish held 360,668 shares or 4.66 percent of the company's shares outstanding, president and chief operating officer Mary Ann Leeper held 371,668 shares or 4.80 percent of the shares outstanding. Director Stephen Dearholt held 604,537 shares or 7.68 percent of the shares outstanding.
